title: The Interior as Not-Self

Ajjhattāyatanaanattasutta The Interior as Not-Self

“Cakkhu, bhikkhave, anattā …pe… jivhā anattā …pe… mano anattā. “Mendicants, the eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are not-self.

Evaṁ passaṁ …pe… Seeing this … nāparaṁ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti. They understand: ‘… there is nothing further for this place.’”
